chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Ibrahim al-Ahmar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who performs salat (prayer) while his buttons are undone. He said: That is not proper.

key_terms.أَزْرَارُهُ: his buttons or fastenings on clothing
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not proper or not fitting

ai.seo_question: Is it proper to perform salat (prayer) with one's buttons undone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning etiquette and proper form in salat (prayer). Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام states that praying with one's buttons undone is not proper, indicating a disliked manner inconsistent with the decorum of worship.
